name: qa-loop
description: Review→fix loop that stops at diminishing returns, not at zero. Runs as a deterministic Workflow (Opus reviews → Opus plans/adjudicates → fixes; gate, churn and stop condition live in code). Anchored to the plan in 3 buckets — implementation / plan-drift / broken-plan — and to the project's own quality goals, read from .claude/docs/quality-goals.md at review time rather than copied into the skill. Regression gate per fix, accepted-limits, a human HTML report plus an agent-facing journal. Replaces qa, rev6 and iterate.
